{{Top|Leg}}
'''Hyberflesh''' was a medical product involved in the making of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacements. Thanks to the [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech]] [[Repli-Limb Prosthetic Replacements|Repli-Limb's]] hyberflesh construction, the line of prosthetics had a nearly spotless record for host tissue acceptance.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
